title: Refine CSV rerun state issue layout
summary: Refined the Queue CSV Rerun state display so backend-owned state rows sit above a separate history panel, compact issue chips replace the inline evidence/reason column, and clicking a chip reveals the detailed rule/evidence text in the existing detail block.
reason: CSV rerun failure rows were hard to scan because long reason/evidence text dominated each row. The operator requested compact issue labels with symbolic category coloring and details available on demand.
behavior_before: CSV rerun queue-state rows rendered issues as comma-separated codes and showed rule reason/evidence inline in a dedicated Evidence column next to the row actions. State and history lived in the same visual flow.
behavior_after: CSV rerun queue-state rows render a severity-colored state badge, compact issue chips grouped by issue family, and no inline Evidence column. State appears above a separate history panel, and clicking an issue chip writes the row's rule/detail evidence into rerun-queue-detail.
rollback_plan: Revert the Queue CSV Rerun HTML, queueView.rerun.js renderer changes, table CSS chip styles, related tests, and regenerated summaries in this packet.
